stemMd: All cables in tray X are insulated. At least one cable in tray Y is not insulated. What must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At least one cable in tray Y is not in tray X.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every cable in tray Y is uninsulated.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No cable in tray Y is in tray X.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every cable in tray X is also in tray Y.

options.label: E
options.textMd: No insulated cable is in tray Y.

explanationMd: The known uninsulated cable in Y cannot belong to X, because every X cable is insulated. That establishes at least one Y member outside X. It does not determine where other Y cables are located.

distractorRationale.c: Only the uninsulated cable is forced outside tray X.
distractorRationale.d: No inclusion of X in Y is given.
distractorRationale.b: Only at least one is specified.
distractorRationale.e: Tray Y may contain other insulated cables.
